abstract.para: Whenever you have created a disaster recovery medium with &rear;, test the disaster recovery process thoroughly. You must use a test machine that has identical hardware like the one that is part of your production environment.

topic.para: After having created the recovery system, test the recovery process on a test machine with identical hardware. Make sure the test machine is correctly set up and can serve as a replacement for your main machine.

warning.title: Extensive testing on identical hardware
warning.para: Thorough testing of the disaster recovery process on machines is required. Test the recovery procedure on a regular basis to ensure everything works as expected.

procedure.title: Performing a disaster recovery on a test machine
